title: Alli Rae header runs edge to edge and the menu is Home | Portfolio | About, the custom builds on Portfolio
detail: Daniel, 2026-10-27: make the header full width, take the individual houses out of the menu, menu is Home | Portfolio | About, Portfolio holds the custom builds. The Designer header and utility bar drop their container inset (Designer CSS only; the shared house header is untouched) and keep the fluid gutter padding. ALLI_RAE_NAV is the new saved menu; the Portfolio page heads its three project cards 'Custom Builds'. Root cause of the houses in the top bar: a saved menu draws only on a Space holding the default-deny space_full_website entitlement, which the seed never granted, so the site drew its automatic menu (every page). update-alli-rae-space-3.sql (scripts/seed-alli-rae-update-3.mts) grants it to this comped Business Space and saves the menu. ALLI_RAE_MENU stays for the first seeds and lib/sites/alli-rae-site.test.ts, which pins its two dropdowns.
